svg.title: Decorrelated jitter spreads the retries of tasks that failed together
svg.desc: Before 0 s, the provider gets its normal load. At 0 s, the provider stops until 120 s, and 1,000 provider.sync requests in progress fail together. With the exponential policy, the 1,000 tasks retry together at 30 s, 90 s, and 210 s. With decorrelated jitter, the load rises smoothly to at most about 580 requests in 5 s and falls slowly.
svg.text: each task: 30 s, then 60 s, then 120 s
baseDelayMs 30 s, the range grows each time
Each bar is the requests to the provider in
5 s. Orange: they fail. Gray: they succeed.
